What if you drank everything through a straw?
Lots of people drink everything through a straw, from water to smoothies. It can help protect your teeth from stains. Dentists even suggest it for drinks like soda and iced coffee.

But here's the twist. Pursing your lips over and over may add to fine lines around your mouth, and you can swallow extra air, which can leave you bloated! Reusable straws are fine, just clean them well.
